name: VigenereWithFixedKeywordCipher

description_json.name: Vigenere with Fixed Keyword CIPHER
description_json.idea: A polyalphabetic substitution cipher using a fixed keyword 'CIPHER' repeated to match the length of the plaintext. Only alphabetic characters are shifted, preserving their case. Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For each alphabetic character in the plaintext, shift it forward in the alphabet by the value of the corresponding letter of the repeating keyword 'CIPHER' (where A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25). The keyword sequence repeats continuously, but the keyword index only advances when an alphabetic character is processed. Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) are copied directly to the ciphertext without shifting, and they do not advance the keyword index. Case is preserved (e.g., shifting 'T' with 'C' (shift of 2) yields 'V', and shifting 'h' with 'I' (shift of 8) yields 'p').
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each alphabetic character in the ciphertext, shift it backward in the alphabet by the value of the corresponding letter of the repeating keyword 'CIPHER' (where A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25). The keyword index only advances when an alphabetic character is processed. Non-alphabetic characters are copied directly to the plaintext without shifting and do not advance the keyword index. Case is preserved.

prompt:
You are an expert on a cipher called: Vigenere with Fixed Keyword CIPHER.

Cipher mechanism is the following: A polyalphabetic substitution cipher using a fixed keyword 'CIPHER' repeated to match the length of the plaintext. Only alphabetic characters are shifted, preserving their case. Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.

Cipher definition:
-encryption: For each alphabetic character in the plaintext, shift it forward in the alphabet by the value of the corresponding letter of the repeating keyword 'CIPHER' (where A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25). The keyword sequence repeats continuously, but the keyword index only advances when an alphabetic character is processed. Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) are copied directly to the ciphertext without shifting, and they do not advance the keyword index. Case is preserved (e.g., shifting 'T' with 'C' (shift of 2) yields 'V', and shifting 'h' with 'I' (shift of 8) yields 'p').
-decryption: For each alphabetic character in the ciphertext, shift it backward in the alphabet by the value of the corresponding letter of the repeating keyword 'CIPHER' (where A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25). The keyword index only advances when an alphabetic character is processed. Non-alphabetic characters are copied directly to the plaintext without shifting and do not advance the keyword index. Case is preserved.
